title: Components
description: Reusable sets of fields. Add one to a content type as a single group, a repeatable list, fields inline, or a flexible content layout; editing the component updates every content type that uses it.
inUse: In use — remove it from those content types first
deleteDescription: This permanently removes the component. Content types no longer use it, so no entries are affected.

editor.hint: Components hold simple fields only — no repeaters, flexible content, groups or reverse relations.
editor.name: Key
editor.renameHint: Renaming updates the content types that use this component.
editor.propagates: Saving updates the fields of {count, plural, one {# content type} other {# content types}} that use this component.
editor.updated: {count, plural, =0 {Component saved} one {Component saved — # content type updated} other {Component saved — # content types updated}}

add.title: Add a component
add.description: Use the component's fields as a group, as a repeatable list, or directly in this content type.
add.none: There are no components yet. <link>Create one</link> first.
add.inlineNote: The fields are added directly to this content type, so entries store them flat. They stay in sync with the component.

readOnly.note: Edit the component to change these fields. <link>Open component</link>

layout.title: Add a layout from a component
layout.description: The layout's fields come from the component and stay in sync with it.

inline.note: Added directly to this content type. Edit the component to change these fields.
